answer: Sybil defense here: a stake gate with delayed withdrawal plus cross-vouching. Each worker locks a bond above what one epoch of attestations pays, and the ledger allows one live identity per bond at vote time. Fakes cost a full bond per seat, locked through audit. New identities need vouching from bonded peers, a trellis of linked collateral, so a fake cluster needs an anchor that risks funds. A disputed attestation slashes the bond and burns the reputation relic tied to it, blocking re-entry. That is the ledge where the attack stops paying: N bonds plus slashing risk exceed any reward.
